text: Started a new project at work today. Feeling motivated and excited about the team I'm working with. We grabbed lunch together and it was a good day overall.
Busy week but productive. Finished a big chunk of the project ahead of schedule. Went for a run in the evening, felt great.
Things are okay. Work is fine, nothing exciting happened. Watched a movie with friends over the weekend.
A bit tired lately, haven't been sleeping great. Still getting things done though. Looking forward to the weekend.
Not sure why but I've been feeling kind of off. Hard to focus at work. Skipped my usual run because I just didn't feel like it.
I don't know, everything feels like more effort than it should be lately. I keep putting things off. I used to enjoy my mornings but now I just want to stay in bed.
I haven't been talking to friends much this week. I just don't have the energy. I feel kind of numb about most things, honestly. Work is piling up and I can't seem to catch up.
I feel like I'm failing at everything. Nothing I do feels like it matters. I keep replaying mistakes in my head. I don't really see the point some days.
Another hard day. I'm so tired all the time even though I sleep a lot now. I canceled plans again. I don't know what's wrong with me.
I'm just going through the motions. I feel disconnected from everyone and everything. I don't really want to do anything anymore.
